overview_description.description: Garner Health is a healthcare technology company that provides a platform designed to help employers and employees access high-performing medical providers. It analyzes clinical performance data and claims information to identify physicians based on quality and outcomes metrics. The company partners with employers to offer benefit programs that include financial incentives for employees who select providers through its platform. It also supports navigation services that assist members in finding and scheduling care. Its model combines data analytics, provider evaluation, and benefits integration to support informed healthcare decisions.

about_short_description.short_description: Garner Health is a healthcare technology company that connects employers and employees with high-performing medical providers.

product.name: Doctor Quality Analytics
product.description: A platform that identifies the top 20% of doctors based on cost, quality of care, and patient reviews to help users find in-network, high-performing healthcare providers.

product.name: Garner DataPro
product.description: A data analytics solution providing detailed, performance-based provider referrals using extensive claims data to evaluate healthcare providers.

product.name: Concierge Service
product.description: A support service that assists users in finding appropriate in-network healthcare providers based on their symptoms or care needs.

product.name: Health Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA) Management
product.description: A service that enables users to manage their employer-provided Health Reimbursement Arrangement benefits and submit documentation for eligible medical expenses.

product.name: Garner Assistant
product.description: An AI-powered assistant that helps members find high-quality doctors, manage appointments, understand benefits, and track claims and reimbursements.
